summary: Plan fails feasibility: No sources provide empirical data comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets. Hypothesis must be revised to match available descriptive evidence.
body: The current plan requires finding 4 sources with controlled experiments comparing dynamic consolidation against static baselines (e.g., append-only) under identical token budgets. A review of the literature (arXiv:2609.19128v1, GitHub:affaan-m/ECC, Anthropic:managed-agents, OpenAI Cookbook) confirms no such sources exist. Existing papers describe methods or lack the specific resource-constrained comparisons needed to test the hypothesis. Forcing this plan will result in a failed research cycle. The hypothesis must be revised to match available evidence (e.g., general performance comparisons without strict budget control) or the scope must be narrowed to a specific, existing benchmark that offers reproducible metrics. Since this is the second review round, we must pivot immediately to a feasible question.
